803-1168-3510-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1168-3510-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

2390-3966-8036.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-8036.description:
Gain life.
Christine Chapel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-4871--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-4871--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

339-677-1251-4247.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4186-5231-6012--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-1308-4094-5478-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
851-1308-4094-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

requires.n: Mana Dork or Mana Dork Creator

4222-7786--140.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding {U}.
Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.
4222-7786--140.notes: The chosen mana-producing creature must produce at least {U}.

1090-2350-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

849-1580-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1322-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1322-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1322-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2440-4720-7082-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Sokka and Suki triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2440-4720-7082-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

465-803-3742-4251-7297.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-4742-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-4742-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

2836-3832-6006.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2836-3832-6006.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to Laboratory Maniac.

1494-6822-6838-7178.description:
If you have more than three cards in hand, activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have three or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Doctor Octopus triggers, causing you to draw at least five cards.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2033-3713-5078-6918.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

654-2653-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
654-2653-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko, Amulet of Vigor and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the Mutavault token.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-3305-4681.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3602-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

671-1981-4416-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
671-1981-4416-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Daxos triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1305-4417-4896-6674.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Rydia by paying {5} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. As There and Back Again enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from There and Back Again.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering its ability, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate eleven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}{W}{U}{B}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Rydia.
Repeat from step 2.

325-2428-5436-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2428-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

3967-4681-4894-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

2440-4730-5663--108.notablePrerequisites: You control a token copy of Sparring Mummy.
2440-4730-5663--108.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Sparring Mummy token.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sparring Mummy trigger, untapping Cayth
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a type with the Sparring Mummy token.
Repeat.
2440-4730-5663--108.notes: You must choose a card from the template that can make a token copy of Sparring Mummy.

690-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
690-6191.description:
Gain life.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3698-5034-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5034-5131.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sol Ring, causing target player to mill three cards.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
When Sol Ring enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

2457-3129-4772-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2178-5231-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
2178-5231-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

191-1689-3017.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
191-1689-3017.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

1479-1817-3478.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1817-3478.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell, with the copy not being legendary.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells.
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Repeat from step 7.

2292-2493-2596-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
2292-2493-2596-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Palinchron, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Palinchron enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.
If the seven lands can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1636-3590-3985.notablePrerequisites: Warchanter Skald has at least one Equipment and/or Aura attached.
1636-3590-3985.description:
Activate Opposition by tapping Warchanter Skald, targeting Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
The Dwarf Berserker enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Opposition ability, tapping Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
The Dwarf Berserker enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2558-3615-3698-3764.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
The Pincher enters the battlefield as a 1/1 creature due to Humility, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Pincher.
Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

1409-1633-3503-3809-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Spectral Arcanist is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-1633-3503-3809-5195.description:
Activate Spectral Arcanist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Spectral Arcanist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Spectral Arcanist.
Resolve the Spectral Arcanist trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing  you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

25-678-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Torsten, adding {1}.
Torsten dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Torsten trigger, creating seven 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Torsten from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Soldiers, adding {4}{G}{W}.
Cast Torsten by paying {5}{G}{W}.
Torsten enters the battlefield, allowing you to search the top seven cards of your library and put any number of creature and/or land cards from them into your hand.
Repeat.

1030-1636-2297-5004.notablePrerequisites: Bjorna and Othelm do not have summoning sickness.
1030-1636-2297-5004.description:
Activate Bjorna by tapping it and sacrificing Cathodion, targeting any creature.
Cathodion dies, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cathodion enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve all Bjorna abilities, dealing infinite damage to any creature(s).

186-539-1247.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
186-539-1247.description:
Activate Pili-Pala's ability from Ashaya by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2525-2947-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, its Vesperlark ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3750-4228.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
An additional creature does not have summoning sickness.
Bear Umbra attached to that additional creature you control.
You control lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3750-4228.description:
Declare enchanted creature as attacker.
Bear Umbra triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Proceed to your next main phase.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
